input.answer: Ontario's CPI rent index (Rent, Ontario, 2002=100) rose 2.0% from September 2025 to September 2026. The index went from 161.2 in 2025-09 to 164.4 in 2026-09. Change: (164.4 − 161.2) / 161.2 × 100 = 3.2 / 161.2 × 100 = 1.985%, which rounds to 2.0%. Figures are not seasonally adjusted. The source table is 18-10-0004 (Consumer Price Index, monthly, not seasonally adjusted), vector 41691954.
